subject: general
question: The minimum age requirement for becoming a member of a Municipality is _________ (prescribed under Article 243V of the Constitution of India).
solution:
The correct answer is **21 years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 243V** of the Constitution of India prescribes the minimum age requirement for becoming a member of a Municipality.
 
• The minimum age requirement is **21 years**.
 
• This provision ensures that members have attained a certain level of maturity and responsibility.
 
• It aligns with the age requirement for other local bodies in India.
 
• The age criterion is part of broader eligibility criteria that may include residency and non-disqualification clauses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Article
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Article 243V
 **Eligibility criteria** for membership in Municipalities, including age, residency, and other qualifications.
 
 

 Article 243Q
 Defines the **constitution of Municipalities** in urban areas.
 
 

 Article 243R
 Provides for the **composition of Municipalities**, including elected and nominated members.
 
 

 Article 243S
 Deals with the **constitution and composition** of Wards Committees.
 
 

 Article 243T
 Provides for **reservation of seats** for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women in Municipalities.
 
 

 Article 243U
 Specifies the **duration of Municipalities** and conditions for their dissolution.
